script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Morning, Sarah. September 10th already. Can you believe it?
script.ja: おはようございます、サラさん。もう9月10日ですね。早いですよね？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Good morning, Alex. Time does fly, doesn't it?
script.ja: おはよう、アレックス。本当に、時間はあっという間ね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: It's pouring out there. My umbrella didn't even help much. What a day.
script.ja: 外は土砂降りですよ。傘もあまり役に立たなかったです。ひどい天気。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yeah, it's moderate rain, but it’s constant. One hundred percent chance all day, I heard.
script.ja: ええ、小雨だけど降りっぱなしね。一日中100パーセントの降水確率だって。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: That explains it. Feels chilly too, around 18 degrees, maybe 20 if we're lucky later. I really need coffee today.
script.ja: なるほど。肌寒いし、18度くらいかな、運が良ければ後で20度くらいか。今日は本当にコーヒーが必要です。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: I've got my tea. Did you get any sleep last night?
script.ja: 私はお茶よ。昨夜は眠れたの？

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Ah, not really. The baby decided midnight was playtime. You know, you forget how much energy they have even when they're tiny.
script.ja: いや、あまり。赤ちゃんが真夜中に遊びの時間だって決めたみたいで。ほら、小さくてもどれだけ体力があるか忘れちゃうんですよね。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: I remember. My son was like that. Then they become teenagers and sleep all day.
script.ja: 分かるわ。うちの息子もそうだった。それがティーンエイジャーになると一日中寝てるのよ。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: I can only dream of that. Speaking of dreams, did you see the news about the tiny house on wheels? A Japanese craftsman built it.
script.ja: それが夢のようですね。夢といえば、車輪付きの小さな家のニュース見ました？日本の職人さんが作ったやつ。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: I saw that. It looked amazing. Very clever use of space.
script.ja: 見たわ。素敵だったわね。空間の使い方がとても巧妙で。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Right? I was thinking, maybe if I had one of those, I could finally get some quiet time. Or maybe just a bigger apartment.
script.ja: でしょう？あれがあれば、ようやく静かな時間が持てるかなって思いました。いや、ただ広いアパートがあればいいのか。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: A bigger apartment might be more practical for your family.
script.ja: ご家族には、もっと広いアパートの方が実用的かもしれないわね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Yeah, you're probably right. Then there was that news about the government looking into cash payments for low-income earners, starting in 2029.
script.ja: ええ、多分そうですね。それから、政府が低所得者層向けの現金給付を2029年から検討してるっていうニュースもありましたね。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Oh, that again. It feels like we hear about that every year, doesn't it?
script.ja: ああ、またその話ね。毎年聞いているような気がするわね？

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Yeah, it does. I mean, it's good that they're thinking about support, but I wonder if it actually helps people in the long run. My office probably won't change anything for us.
script.ja: ええ、そうですね。支援を考えてくれるのは良いことだけど、長期的に見て本当に役立つのかどうか。うちの会社では、何も変わらないでしょうね。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It's a complex issue. Sometimes these things are done in a rather piecemeal way.
script.ja: 複雑な問題だわね。時々、こういうことはかなり場当たり的に行われるから。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Piecemeal? What does that mean?
script.ja: 場当たり的？それってどういう意味ですか？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It means done in stages, or bit by bit, instead of all at once. Like small parts, not a complete plan.
script.ja: 一度に全部ではなく、段階的に、少しずつ行われることよ。小さな部分に分けて、全体的な計画ではない感じね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Ah, I see. Yeah, that makes sense. It feels like that sometimes. Anyway, the Fukushima story was really uplifting. Fish, tomatoes, hula-dancing girls. It's amazing how they're rebuilding.
script.ja: ああ、なるほど。ええ、それがしっくりきますね。時々、そんな感じがします。ところで、福島のニュースは本当に感動しましたね。魚にトマトに、フラガール。復興の仕方がすごいですね。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It shows a lot of resilience. People working together to create a new future.
script.ja: それは、多くの回復力を示しているわ。人々が協力して新しい未来を創造しているのね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Totally. Oh, hey, speaking of helping people, did you know today is 警察相談の日?
script.ja: 全くですね。ああ、そうだ、人を助ける話といえば、今日が「警察相談の日」って知ってました？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yes, it's for the #9110 police consultation number. For non-emergency calls.
script.ja: ええ、#9110の警察相談の番号にちなんでいるのよね。緊急ではない相談を受け付けているわ。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Right, right. So, if you have something like... I don't know, a weird neighbor, or maybe a suspicious package, but it's not a 110 emergency. Just general stuff?
script.ja: そうそう。だから、もし何か…なんだろう、変な隣人とか、怪しい荷物とか、でも110番する緊急事態じゃない時とかですか？ただの雑多なこと？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Exactly. For a variety of issues that need police advice but aren't urgent incidents.
script.ja: その通りよ。警察のアドバイスが必要だけど、緊急の事件ではない、さまざまな問題のためね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: I didn't know that. That's actually really useful to know. Like a general information line for miscellaneous police stuff?
script.ja: 知りませんでした。それ、実はすごく役立つ情報ですね。雑多な警察関連の情報のホットラインみたいな？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: Yes, 'miscellaneous' is a good word for it. It means various kinds of things, often not easily categorized.
script.ja: ええ、「miscellaneous」で合っているわ。さまざまな種類の、よく分類しにくいもののことね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Got it. Miscellaneous. I'll remember that. So, Sarah, what's new in your garden these days? Still growing those amazing tomatoes?
script.ja: 分かりました。Miscellaneous。覚えておきます。それで、サラさん、最近庭では何か新しいことありますか？あの素晴らしいトマト、まだ育ててます？

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: The tomatoes are finished for the season, unfortunately. But my basil did really well this year. I made a lot of pesto.
script.ja: トマトは残念ながら今シーズンはもう終わりよ。でも、今年のバジルはすごくよく育ったわ。たくさんジェノベーゼソースを作ったの。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Oh, that's great! I love pesto. My wife tried growing herbs on the balcony, but it didn't really take off.
script.ja: ああ、それは素晴らしい！ジェノベーゼ大好きです。妻がベランダでハーブを育てようとしたんですけど、あまりうまくいきませんでした。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: It takes time. And patience. Even my daughter helps out sometimes. It's satisfying to see things grow.
script.ja: 時間がかかるものよ。そして忍耐も。うちの娘でさえ、たまに手伝ってくれるわ。物が育つのを見るのは満足感があるわね。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: I guess so. Maybe I should try with my kid when he's a bit older. Right now, he mostly just wants to eat the dirt.
script.ja: そうですね。もう少し大きくなったら、うちの子と一緒にやってみようかな。今は、ほとんど土を食べたがりますね。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: That's normal.
script.ja: それは普通よ。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: Yeah, I guess so. Well, I think that's all the news for The Daily Tanu-chan Show today. Thanks for joining me, Sarah.
script.ja: ええ、そうでしょうね。さて、今日の『ザ・デイリーたぬちゃんショー』のニュースはここまでですね。サラさん、ありがとうございました。

script.speaker: Sarah
script.text: You're welcome, Alex. Have a good day, everyone.
script.ja: どういたしまして、アレックス。皆さん、良い一日を。

script.speaker: Alex
script.text: See you tomorrow!
script.ja: また明日！
